edges.reason: Constructor assigns the owner role directly from msg.sender.
Constructor assigns the controller role directly from msg.sender.
pause is protected by onlyController which compares msg.sender to controller.
unpause is protected by onlyController which compares msg.sender to controller.
setOwner is protected by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
setController is protected by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
mint requires msg.sender to equal the controller state variable.
burn requires msg.sender to equal the controller state variable.
The owner state variable gates the execution of setOwner.
The controller state variable gates the execution of setController.
The controller state variable authorizes the mint call.
The controller state variable authorizes the burn call.
The controller state variable authorizes pause.
The controller state variable authorizes unpause.
The newOwner parameter flows into the ownership reassignment.
The newController parameter flows into the controller reassignment.
setOwner triggers the privileged write to the owner variable.
setController triggers the privileged write to the controller variable.
The privileged write updates the owner state variable.
The privileged write updates the controller state variable.
The account parameter is passed to _mint from mint.
The amount parameter is passed to _mint from mint.
The account parameter is passed to _burn from burn.
The amount parameter is passed to _burn from burn.
mint performs the supply and balance mutation guarded only by the controller check.
burn performs the balance and supply mutation guarded only by the controller check.
mint delegates the actual accounting to the internal _mint function.
burn delegates the actual accounting to the internal _burn function.
Minting increases the recipient balance entry in _balances.
Minting increases the _totalSupply state variable.
Burning decreases the target balance entry in _balances.
Burning decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
pause writes true into the _paused state variable.
unpause writes false into the _paused state variable.
The _paused flag is checked by whenNotPaused before minting.
The _paused flag is checked by whenNotPaused before burning.
transfer uses _msgSender, which is msg.sender, as the sending account.
transferFrom uses _msgSender, which is msg.sender, as the spender.
transfer delegates balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates balance movement to _transfer.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the _allowances mapping.
